rca_of_tc13_issue: STO-GENERIC-10 coupon configured in CRM preprod with stackable_with_loyalty=false. App code at ReviewOrder.jsx line 909: `const stackable = data.stackable_with_loyalty !== false` correctly reads this field. The guard at handleUsePoints blocks loyalty when couponStackable=false. Since CRM data says false, loyalty is blocked. Either CRM coupon config needs update (set stackable_with_loyalty=true for STO-GENERIC-10) or spec is incorrect about this coupon being stackable.
